description: This file defines an interface `TokenInterface` in the `Aws	oken` namespace, which provides a contract for AWS token objects, including methods to retrieve token data, expiration, check expiration status, and convert to array.

classes.name: TokenInterface
classes.description: Defines methods for AWS token objects, acting as a contract for accessing token data, expiration, and serialization.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the token as a string used for AWS service access.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the UNIX timestamp when the token expires, or null if it does not expire.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the token has expired, returning a boolean.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the token's data into an associative array.
